program.source: export function evaluate({ inputs, time }) { const u = inputs.launchSpeed; const g = inputs.gravity; const m = inputs.mass; const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(time, 2 * u / g)); const y = u * t - 0.5 * g * t * g; const v = u - g * t; const a = -g; const F = m * g; const apexTime = u / g; const apexHeight = (u * u) / (2 * g); let motionState = "Ready to toss"; if (t > 0 && t < apexTime) motionState = "Rising"; else if (Math.abs(t - apexTime) <= 0.02) motionState = "At the top"; else if (t > apexTime && y > 0) motionState = "Falling"; else if (y <= 0 && t > 0) motionState = "Back at launch height"; const objects = []; objects.push(...sdk.panel({ x: 20, y: 30, w: 280, h: 330, title: "Motion", state: motionState })); objects.push(sdk.axis("axis.y", { x: 80, y: 320, length: 240, orientation: "y", min: 0, max: 2.2, ticks: [0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0], label: "Height", unit: "m" })); const ballY = 320 - (y / 2.2) * 240; objects.push(sdk.circle("ball.toss", 160, ballY, 26, { role: "output" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.v", { x: 190, y: ballY }, { value: v, direction: "up" }, { scale: 12, minLength: 12, label: "v" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.a", { x: 220, y: ballY }, { value: a, direction: "up" }, { scale: 12, minLength: 12, label: "a" })); objects.push(...sdk.callout(245, ballY - 20, [`v: ${v.toFixed(2)} m/s`, `a: ${a.toFixed(1)} m/s^2`, `Fg: ${F.toFixed(1)} N`], { id: "callout.toss" })); const seriesPoints = sdk.sample((ti) => u - g * ti, 0, Math.min(t, 1.666), 20).map(([ti, vi]) => ({ x: ti, y: vi })); objects.push(sdk.plot("plot.vt", { x: 320, y: 30, w: 300, h: 330, axes: { x: { label: "Time", min: 0, max: 1.66, unit: "s" }, y: { label: "Velocity", min: -5.5, max: 5.5, unit: "m/s" } }, series: [{ label: "v(t)", kind: "line", points: seriesPoints }] })); objects.push(sdk.text("plot.vt.note", 340, 350, "Slope a = -g")); return { frame: { width: 640, height: 420, objects, readouts: [{ id: "velocity", value: v }, { id: "acceleration", value: a }, { id: "force", value: F }, { id: "motionState", value: motionState }] }, quantities: { launchSpeed: u, gravity: g, mass: m, apexTime, apexHeight, height: y, velocity: v, acceleration: a, force: F } }; }

manifest.title: Zero velocity. Nonzero acceleration.
manifest.summary: At the top, velocity is zero, but acceleration and force remain constant.
manifest.description: A ball tossed vertically on a height ruler next to a velocity-time graph. Controls allow adjusting launch speed, gravity, and mass.
assumptions: No air resistance, up is positive.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed or gravity, then press Play. Compare readings at the top.
